source: Gillerman, V.S., Feeney, D.M., Canada, A.S., and Schmidt, K.L., 2021, Geologic Map of the De Lamar and Swisher Mountain Quadrangles, Owyhee County, Idaho, Idaho Geological Survey Digital Web Map 193, scale 1:24,000.
description_note: Concise paraphrases of the official DWM-193 description of map units; consult the publication for full descriptions.

m.name: Made ground
m.lithology: Artificial fill, tailings, mine dump and road material
m.description: Excavated and transported material, including tailings and mine dumps near the De Lamar and Florida Mountain mines.

p.name: Placered ground
p.description: Ground disturbed by historic placer mining and dredging.

Qas.name: Stream alluvium
Qas.description: Modern and late Pleistocene channel and overbank deposits derived from basalt, rhyolite, dacite and granite.

Qaf.name: Alluvial fan deposits
Qaf.description: Young unconsolidated fan aprons at valley floors.

Qat.name: Alluvial terrace deposits
Qat.description: Pleistocene terrace deposits above modern Soda and Cow Creek flood plains.

Qafo.name: Older alluvial fan deposits
Qafo.lithology: Poorly sorted sand, silt, clay and rounded gravel
Qafo.description: Eroded middle-to-late Pleistocene fan surfaces above modern drainages.

Qls.name: Landslide deposits
Qls.description: Young translational bedrock-slide deposits with rhyolite and basalt clasts.

QTg.name: Gravel
QTg.description: Lag and fan gravel derived from rhyolite, granite, locally silicified units and basalt.

Tcg.name: Conglomerate and coarse gravel
Tcg.description: Alluvial-fan deposits with rhyolite, chert, dacite, basalt and Cretaceous granite clasts.

Tsi.name: Intercalated fine-grained sediments
Tsi.lithology: Clay, mudstone, siltstone and carbonaceous sediment
Tsi.description: Intravolcanic sediment locally interpreted as an aquitard that ponded hydrothermal fluids beneath the banded rhyolite at De Lamar.

Tsu.name: Succor Creek Formation
Tsu.lithology: Tuffaceous mudstone, siltstone, sandstone, conglomerate and ash
Tsu.description: Lacustrine and volcaniclastic strata; locally includes silicified mud and possible hot-spring-pool sediment intercalated with lower basalt.

Tbb.name: Baxter Basin mixed deposits
Tbb.lithology: Palagonite tuff, water-affected basalt and sediment
Tbb.description: Massive palagonite tuff, hyaloclastite-textured basalt, silt, clay and ash deposited in Baxter Basin.

Tri.name: Intrusive rhyolite dikes and plugs
Tri.description: Aphyric to fine-grained rhyolite dikes and plugs, locally oxidized, with quartz-bearing devitrified groundmass.

Tad.name: Andesite dikes
Tad.description: Dark, very fine-grained to aphyric andesite dikes with sparse plagioclase.

Tbd.name: Basalt dikes
Tbd.description: Basalt dikes in Baxter Basin, likely feeders to water-affected basalt and palagonite tuff.

Trpc.name: Rhyodacite of Pole Creek
Trpc.description: Altered flow-banded dikes and hypabyssal plugs with spherulites and chalcedony-filled amygdules.

Trsm.name: Swisher Mountain Rhyolite
Trsm.description: Large, relatively young compound rhyolite flows and domes with a U-Pb age near 14.746 Ma; generally fresher than mineralized rhyolites.

Tbm.name: Rhyolite of Black Mountain
Tbm.description: Flow-banded rhyolite and local lahar breccia, approximately 15.7 Ma.

Tbml.name: Lower rhyolite of Black Mountain
Tbml.lithology: Crystal-rich and lithic tuff with basalt
Tbml.description: Discontinuous tuff and intercalated basalt beneath the Black Mountain rhyolite.

Trss.name: Rhyolite of Sommercamp Spring
Trss.description: Cliff-forming rhyolite with vapor-phase silica and chalcedony-filled lithophysae; U-Pb age near 15.722 Ma.

Trwp.name: Rhyolite of west prospects
Trwp.description: Strongly auto-brecciated rhyolite, locally silicified and containing clasts of sinter or jasperoid; U-Pb age near 16.176 Ma.

Tre.name: Rhyolite of Elordi ranch
Tre.description: Banded porphyritic rhyolite domes or short-travelled flows with chalcedony- or opal-filled cavities.

Trc.name: Rhyolite of Cow Creek
Trc.description: Banded rhyolite that is strongly silicified at Twin Peaks and contains iron oxides after pyrite, quartz veins and local illite or muscovite alteration.

Trs.name: Rhyolite of Slaughterhouse Gulch
Trs.description: Extensively altered domes and flows with chalcedony-filled cavities; silicified sediment along faults may record hot-spring pools. U-Pb age near 16.206 Ma.

Trtm.name: Rhyolite of Tennessee Mountain
Trtm.description: Oxidized and locally silicified rhyolite dome with clay-sericite alteration and possible hydrothermal breccia near historic workings.

Tsmr.name: Millsite rhyolite of Silver City
Tsmr.description: Relatively unaltered rhyolite younger than the main De Lamar ore-hosting units; U-Pb age near 15.706 Ma.

Tsbr.name: Banded rhyolite of Silver City
Tsbr.description: Pervasively silicified, altered, oxidized and brecciated major De Lamar ore-host unit; U-Pb age near 16.334 Ma.

Tspr.name: Porphyritic rhyolite of Silver City
Tspr.description: Major ore host at De Lamar and pervasively altered, mineralized, oxidized and silicified around Florida Mountain; U-Pb age near 16.389 Ma.

Tstb.name: Tuff breccia
Tstb.description: Pervasively altered phreatomagmatic tuff breccia with local chlorite, clay and sparse pyrite near the De Lamar and Florida Mountain domes.

Tbsm.name: Basalt of Spring Mountain
Tbsm.description: Subaerial and subaqueous basalt flows in the southwest map area.

Tdg.name: Dacite vent deposits of Glass Hill
Tdg.description: Obsidian-bearing vent deposits and small flows at Glass Hill, approximately 14.54 Ma.

Tlq.name: Quartz latite
Tlq.description: Widespread plagioclase-bearing flows, commonly altered around Florida Mountain and the Glen Silver pit, with quartz, clay and carbonate amygdules.

Tlp.name: Porphyritic latite
Tlp.description: Platy intermediate flows with sericitized plagioclase, clay replacement and local alteration adjacent to the mines.

Tbuj.name: Glassy basalt of upper Johnston Lake
Tbuj.description: Proximal glassy basalt flow, probably related to the high-basalt unit.

Thb.name: High basalt
Thb.lithology: Basalt, basaltic andesite and local mafic tuff
Thb.description: Heterogeneous upper basalt flows interbedded locally with silicic tuff dated near 16.258 Ma.

Ttu.name: Silicic tuffs undivided
Ttu.description: Pumice- and lithic-bearing silicic tuff; one bed intercalated with high basalt dates near 16.258 Ma.

Tlb.name: Lower basalt
Tlb.description: Stacked, strongly magnetic Steens Basalt-correlative sheet flows emplaced across prevolcanic topography.

Kgd.name: Granodiorite
Kgd.description: Silver City granitoid basement, locally cut by aplite and pegmatite dikes; approximately 62–66 Ma.

sinter.name: Sinter and silicified zone
sinter.lithology: Hot-spring sinter, jasperoid and massive chalcedonic silicification
sinter.description: Mapped surface hot-spring deposits and silicified zones, including laminated silica mats, replacement silica, local hydrothermal breccia, bladed quartz after calcite and precious-metal anomalies. These overlay polygons are scored independently from their host units.
